title: ASTRA: Automated Simulation of TRAnsportation networks for SUMO
description: ASTRA supports SUMO network construction, demand calibration, simulation, and result review. It provides four topic skills, command-line tools, and optional local MCP tools. Version 1.3.1 corrects citation metadata and enables Zenodo archiving. Traffic models and simulation behavior are unchanged from ASTRA 1.3.0. ASTRA continues Torii in a new repository; the preceding Torii release remains available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22677168.
